game_concept: A tower defense set in Mt. Pyre – Smoke Ridge, a ridge shrouded in ash: the ember mage must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Sorter: Sort falling fire gems into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Smoke Ridge: a ridge shrouded in ash
core_gameplay_loop: In Smoke Ridge, repeat each round: Sort falling fire gems into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground. Each round, smoke serpents strike the magma valve, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the sorted_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the magma valve from smoke serpents in Smoke Ridge: keep the sorted_ok meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 63-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: sorted_ok drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 63-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 6 (applied tier): Type Sorter
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how sorted_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smoke serpents in Smoke Ridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 63 seconds while sorted_ok > 0.
